newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Williams sees more acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Williams sees more acquisitions.

text.p: Acquisitive British group Williams Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it remains on the takeover trail, but now that other conglomerates have fallen out of fashion it will take pleasure in sticking to the paths it knows.
"We have a lot of (potential) acquisitions on the radar at the moment," chief executive Roger Carr said in an interview.

"There are lots of interesting companies both large and small," he said. But mindful of the problems of groups such as BTR and Hanson he said he was happy for Williams to stick to its core areas of fire protection, security and building products.
